arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Banks claims prosecutors promised to disclose discoverable material to the defense.
Banks argues his defense counsel was constitutionally deficient during the trial.
The state asserts Banks failed to diligently pursue his current claims.
The state notes Banks chose to pursue other claims in state court instead.
